meta.title: eBook Cadeau business model inputs
meta.simulation_start: 2027-01 (month 1 = January 2027, so months 12, 24 and 36 are Decembers)
meta.warning: No value in this file is a quote. The research pages were read as search-result extracts only and the three fact-checkers could not run a single web search, so nothing was re-verified at source. Values tagged 'assumption' have no source at all.

fields.low / base / high: Range used by the model. Monte Carlo draws a triangular distribution over it; 'low' is the numerically smaller value, not necessarily the pessimistic one.
fields.role: 'decision' = a price or budget the owner chooses (held at base in Monte Carlo, swung in the tornado); 'uncertain' = an unknown of the world; 'fixed' = a single value (tariff or legal rate).
fields.vat: 'HT' = quoted excluding VAT: the model adds 20 % when the business is under the VAT franchise (micro-entreprise) and cannot recover it. 'TTC' = consumer price including VAT. 'none' = not a VAT-bearing amount, or VAT status unknown and taken as is.
fields.confidence: V2 = two independent sources in the research; V1 = one source; M = researcher's memory; derived = arithmetic on other rows; assumption = planning value with no source.
fields.factcheck: Present when the fact-check report changed or contested the value. The fact-check wins where it rests on arithmetic or on the repository; where it rests on the checker's memory the conflicting figures are kept as the range.

documents.MODEL: introduced by this model; no research source

price_paid_pdf.note: Only used by the 'small fee' variant of scenario A. R12 tests 0 / 0 / 1.99 (anchor: Popcarte virtual card from 1.99); 0.99 and 2.99 are this model's bracket. The free variant ignores it.

price_mailed_card.unit: EUR per card, incl. VAT and postage
price_mailed_card.note: Benchmark for a folded card mailed in France: 3.7 / 4.3 / 6.9 (R12 5.1).

price_reseller_fee_per_card.unit: EUR per card generated, excl. VAT

price_reseller_monthly_minimum.unit: EUR per reseller per month, excl. VAT
price_reseller_monthly_minimum.section: 5.4 Price points to test (reseller flat licence)
price_reseller_monthly_minimum.note: R12 prices a flat licence; the model uses the same amounts as the monthly minimum of a metered fee: invoice = max(minimum, cards x fee).

price_author_plan.unit: EUR per author per year, incl. VAT
price_author_plan.note: Anchor: BookFunnel plans that allow print codes, USD 200-300 a year (unverified, FC12 claim 16).

price_author_jacket.unit: EUR per jacket in a pack of 100, incl. VAT
price_author_jacket.note: Treated as a VAT-inclusive price because most self-published authors cannot recover VAT. Anchor: Dropcards USD 0.33-0.45 for a much smaller card.

fulfil_card_print.section: 3.4 One card printed and mailed (Merci Facteur folded card, envelope included)
fulfil_card_print.factcheck: FC04 claims 1-3 and FC12 claim 13: single vendor (V1, not V2); whether 2.99 is excl. or incl. VAT is unknown (high = 2.99 x 1.2); nothing shows the API accepts custom artwork on all four panels.
fulfil_card_print.note: Single-fold 15 x 21 cm card, not the true jacket with a 10 mm spine.

fulfil_postage.factcheck: FC12: the landed cost should be 4.29 / about 5.3 / 6.33 or more, not 4.29 / 4.29 / 4.79. Low = Merci Facteur 'from 1.30' (a floor); high = public Lettre verte 100 g rate from 1 January 2027 (3.34, itself unverified); base = midpoint, which with the print line gives the fact-check's 5.30.
fulfil_postage.note: Until a test invoice exists this is the weakest cost input of the mailed card.

postage_yearly_increase.note: One year of evidence (2026 to 2027). Applied to the postage line from the second simulated year.

pay_card_pct.factcheck: FC12 claim 7: 2.8 % for premium EEA cards is probably a comparator error (checker's memory: 1.9 %). Kept as the high end.
pay_card_pct.note: Mollie domestic / Stripe standard EEA / Stripe premium.

pay_sepa_pct.note: SEPA direct debit for monthly reseller invoices.

pay_sepa_cap.factcheck: FC12 claim 8: the cap is probably 4.00 (checker's memory). Kept as the high end.

print_jacket_pack100.unit: EUR per jacket, excl. VAT, runs of 100-500
print_jacket_pack100.factcheck: FC04 claim 10 and section 3: 'no analogue; label as a pure guess'. Only one printer priced a folded A6 (0.52-0.59); a pocket jacket has about 30 % more sheet area and two creases.
print_jacket_pack100.note: No quote obtained. Three quotes from French trade printers are the cheapest way to fix this.

print_variable_data_surcharge.section: R12 7.3 item 7 says variable data was 'not priced anywhere'
print_variable_data_surcharge.note: Unique code per jacket. Low = one shared code with a redemption cap (the Bookwire pattern).

pack_shipping.section: 3.1 (delivery to one French address is included by the web-to-print shops read)
pack_shipping.note: Base assumes the printer ships straight to the author. High = one parcel re-shipped by the founder.

var_infra_per_card.section: R12 6.3 hosting rows (storage 0.01 EUR/GB, egress 0.01 EUR/GB)
var_infra_per_card.note: PDF, QR and font work run in the browser; the server stores a code record and serves the redemption page.

support_b2b_ticket_rate.section: R12 section 9 step 3 lists 'support tickets per 1,000 cards' as a thing to measure

pack_prepress_minutes.note: File check, order placement with the printer, follow-up.

partner_account_hours_month.unit: hours per live reseller per month

partner_onboarding_days.note: Integration support. Founder time at the minimal level; absorbed by the paid developer at seed and funded.

labour_support_hourly_cost.section: 7.2 ('at 5 minutes a card and EUR 20 an hour')
labour_support_hourly_cost.note: Cash cost of support and handling at seed and funded. At the minimal level the same hours are founder time.

founder_hourly_value.note: 5,275 / 151.67 hours = 34.8. Used only in the 'founder time valued' view; never in the cash view.

tax_micro_social_goods.factcheck: FC04 claim 20: 12.3 % is the rate for sales of goods; if the mailed card or the packs are classed as a service the rate is 21.2 %. Kept as the high end.
tax_micro_social_goods.note: Micro-entreprise only (minimal level). Applied to mailed cards and printed packs.

tax_micro_social_services.factcheck: FC12 claim 9: if the activity is classed BNC the 2026 rate is probably 26.1 % (checker's memory), not the 25.6 % in R12. Kept as the high end. The training levy (0.1-0.3 %) is not included.
tax_micro_social_services.note: Micro-entreprise only. Applied to reseller fees, author plans and paid PDFs.

tax_vat_standard.note: Card, postage charged, PDF fee, reseller fee and author plan are all standard-rated. The eBook itself (5.5 %) is never sold by eBook Cadeau (R09 6.5, art. 9a).

tax_vat_franchise_services.unit: EUR of service turnover per 12 months
tax_vat_franchise_services.factcheck: FC12 claim 10 and FC09 claim 15: 85,000 / 37,500 are the current pair (91,900 / 36,800 were the 2023-2024 figures). A single 25,000 threshold was voted for 2025, suspended, then dropped: a regulatory risk.
tax_vat_franchise_services.note: Above it the micro-entreprise charges VAT.

tax_vat_franchise_total.unit: EUR of total turnover per 12 months
tax_vat_franchise_total.note: Mixed activity: total turnover under this figure and services under the services figure.

tax_micro_ceiling_services.unit: EUR of service turnover per year
tax_micro_ceiling_services.note: Above it the micro regime ends. The model only raises a flag; it does not convert the business.

tax_cfe_exempt_turnover.unit: EUR of turnover in the previous year
tax_cfe_exempt_turnover.note: Checker's memory: no minimum CFE at or below EUR 5,000 of turnover.

fix_hosting_month.factcheck: FC12 section 2 item 2 and R12 risk 20: budget 25 rather than 10. All three EU hosts raised prices in 2026; prices unverified.
fix_hosting_month.note: Small API server and object storage with an EU host.

fix_domains_year.note: Main domain plus a short domain for the typed code.

fix_cfe_year.unit: EUR per year, from the second year
fix_cfe_year.factcheck: FC12 omission 5: nil when the previous year's turnover is EUR 5,000 or less. The model applies that exemption.

fix_einvoicing_month.note: Every business must be able to receive e-invoices since 1 September 2026 and small ones must issue them from 1 September 2027. The cost of a platform is this model's guess.

fix_epr_year.unit: EUR per year, only when printed cards are sold
fix_epr_year.section: 11.2 EPR in France (flat-rate declaration for very small quantities; amount not found)
fix_epr_year.note: Listed in R12 risk 17 as an unpriced compliance cost.

fix_postal_api_month.unit: EUR per month, only when mailed cards are sold
fix_postal_api_month.factcheck: FC04 section 3: every V2 on Merci Facteur prices is V1 (single vendor).
fix_postal_api_month.note: High = plan above about 2,000 cards a month.

fix_accountant_micro_year.section: R12 6.3 says an accountant is 'not needed for a micro-entreprise'

fix_accountant_company_year.note: Online accountant for a SASU (seed, funded).

fix_tools_funded_month.note: Same, for a team of three.

setup_legal_templates.note: Terms of sale and privacy documents from templates (minimal level).

setup_legal_lawyer.note: Same documents drafted by a lawyer (seed, funded).

setup_counsel_before_reseller.unit: EUR one-off, paid when the first reseller goes live
setup_counsel_before_reseller.section: 13 Questions for counsel and the accountant; R12 risk 6 ('lawyer review before a reseller launch')
setup_counsel_before_reseller.note: Fixed-price law, 'prime' risk, VAT position, reseller contract. The amount is this model's guess.

setup_trademark_inpi.note: One to three classes. Only worth paying for a distinctive name (R12 risk 18).

setup_company_formation.note: Registering a SASU (seed, funded). Not researched.

setup_samples_test_orders.section: 9 Go-to-market, step 1 (EUR 50-250 for two or three pilot runs)
setup_samples_test_orders.note: Sample prints and test orders, to weigh and to obtain a real invoice.

setup_build_completion.section: How to resume (about USD 7-8 per agent run; option B about 30 runs, option A about 100)
setup_build_completion.note: Cash cost of finishing the software with coding agents. The owner's own time is counted in founder hours.

minimal_founder_hours_month.note: About one to two days a week, before support and handling time, which the model adds.

seed_dev_days_month.note: The 'part-time developer' of the seed level.

seed_marketing_month.note: Spent only on channels that can use it (consumer generator, authors).

funded_founder_salary_month.unit: EUR per month, total employer cost
funded_founder_salary_month.note: EUR 3,000 net a month for a SASU president.

funded_dev_cost_month.unit: EUR per month, total employer cost

funded_bizdev_cost_month.unit: EUR per month, total employer cost

funded_marketing_month.note: Spent only on channels that can use it, and only up to the market caps below.

b2c_organic_cards_month_start.unit: free cards generated per month at launch, before seasonality
b2c_organic_cards_month_start.section: 9 step 0 (gate: at least 200 cards in a season); 7.4 low case (3,060 cards a year in year 3, standalone only)
b2c_organic_cards_month_start.note: With the base growth rate this reaches about 2,800 cards in year 3.

b2c_organic_growth_month.note: Word of mouth and search, no paid acquisition.

b2c_cac_per_card.unit: EUR of advertising per extra card generated
b2c_cac_per_card.note: Not researched. Compare with what one generated card earns: upgrade share x contribution of a mailed card.

b2c_mailed_upgrade_share.note: Share of people using the free generator who pay for the printed-and-posted card.

b2c_paid_pdf_conversion.unit: fraction of would-be free users who still pay
b2c_paid_pdf_conversion.section: R12 7.1 A' ('free alternatives; conversion unknown'); FC12 omission 3 (Amazon.fr and Fnac give free print-at-home gift cards)
b2c_paid_pdf_conversion.note: Only used by the 'small fee' variant.

b2c_sam_cards_year.factcheck: FC12 claims 1 and 5 and finding 3: built on assumed gift share (3-12 %) and non-Amazon share (40-60 %); the panel scope is unknown.
b2c_sam_cards_year.note: Used with the next row to cap the standalone channel.

b2c_standalone_cap_share.unit: fraction of the SAM the standalone generator can reach
b2c_standalone_cap_share.note: Paid acquisition cannot push the standalone channel above SAM x this share.

season_december_share.unit: fraction of yearly consumer cards generated in December
season_december_share.section: 2 Internal findings, item 5; R12 3.1 (December = 17-21 % of French book revenue)
season_december_share.factcheck: FC12: the 45-55 % peak share in R12 is far above the cited evidence. Low = December share of book revenue (V2); high = R12's assumption; base = this model's guess for a gift-only product.
season_december_share.note: Applies to the consumer generator and to reseller cards, not to author packs.

reseller_attach_rate.unit: fraction of a reseller's eBook orders that use the gift card
reseller_attach_rate.section: 6.3 Table (demand_attach_rate); 3.3 item 2 ('no source gives the attach rate')
reseller_attach_rate.note: The single most important unknown of the reseller channel.

reseller_orders_small.section: R12 2.4 (17 M paid eBooks a year in France); retailer shares 'not found'
reseller_orders_small.note: About 0.3 / 0.5 / 1 % of French units: an open-file store of the 7switch type.

reseller_orders_mid.note: About 2 / 3 / 5 % of French units: one storefront of a bookseller network.

reseller_orders_large.section: 2.5 cross-checks ('one reseller holding about 8 % of French eBook units')
reseller_orders_large.note: About 6 / 8 / 20 % of French units: a platform of the Fnac/Kobo class.

reseller_ramp_months.unit: months for a new reseller to reach its attach rate

reseller_annual_churn.unit: probability per year that a reseller stops
reseller_annual_churn.section: R12 4.4 lesson 6 and risk 5 (dependence on one partner killed Livrada and Enthrill); 7.3 item 6 (the code is BSD-3-Clause)
reseller_annual_churn.note: Applied as an expected value: revenue is multiplied by the survival probability.

minimal_first_partner_month.unit: simulation month of the first live reseller
minimal_first_partner_month.section: 9 step 3 (talks from January 2027, live by October 2027)

minimal_months_between_partners.note: Pace of reseller sales by a solo founder.

funded_months_between_partners.note: With a half-time partnerships person; includes resellers outside France from the second year.

minimal_max_partners.note: What one person can integrate and support.

seed_max_partners.section: R12 4.2 (France is fragmented by platform: Kobo, Vivlio, ePagine, Immatériel and a few others)
seed_max_partners.note: Roughly the number of eBook platforms in France.

funded_max_partners.note: France plus Germany and the next markets.

minimal_authors_new_month.unit: new paying authors per month, unpaid acquisition
minimal_authors_new_month.section: 7.4 (20 / 100 / 300 authors on the plan in year 3); 9 step 1
minimal_authors_new_month.note: Fairs, author groups, word of mouth.

seed_authors_new_month.unit: new paying authors per month, unpaid acquisition

funded_authors_new_month.unit: new paying authors per month, unpaid acquisition

author_cac.unit: EUR of marketing per extra paying author

author_annual_churn.unit: fraction of paying authors lost per year

author_packs_per_year.unit: packs of 100 jackets per paying author per year
author_packs_per_year.section: 7.4 (50 packs for 100 authors in the base case)

author_market_cap.section: 2.5 (10,000-20,000 self-published authors active at signings, 2-5 % adopt; nothing could be searched)
author_market_cap.factcheck: FC12 claim 17: the evidence supports 'authors pay for delivery tooling', not 'authors pay for printed code cards'.
author_market_cap.note: Ceiling on the author base at every investment level.

mkt_split_authors.unit: share of the marketing budget spent on authors when consumers are also targeted
